environment.mode: headed; brought to front; no autoplay override

workload: Same generated five-minute 48 kHz stereo PCM16 WAV, impulse each fourth sample with left amplitude 1/64 and right 2/64; fixture generation excluded. Same CDP pointer probe (20 ms), timer (10 ms), rAF, 10 ms readiness polling, and phase paint waits.
profiling: Responsiveness-only Vite transforms time calls without changing production modules. Nested durations must be subtracted, not added. whole-record total for generators sums active next() durations and excludes task waits. before/indexed/incremental/budgeted include initial demo marks before copy; final and before-2/3 clear marks first.
limitations: Small sequential local sample, not randomized or a cross-device guarantee. Synchronous copying, validation, analyzer setup and waveform remain. No physical sync, native-memory, dropped-frame or manual acceptance claim. Native AudioContext startup is separate and unresolved.
